Seven control servos: two aileron, two flap, two elevator and one rudder, from the seven dedicated inventory IDs. The source estimates the aileron/flap servos at about 80 g and 20-25 kg·cm, and the elevator pair at about 80 g each. Team Savox lists SA-1230SG+ as a standard AIRPLANE servo, 79 g and 36 kg·cm at 6 V; ServoCity lists $103.39. It is a mass/class value proxy with higher stated torque, not an installed identity or fit qualification. ServoCity gives no stock count, so seven-unit availability is unestablished; the rudder row also contains pull-pull hardware that is not priced by this servo quote.

The physical row explicitly groups two small throttle/choke servos with linkage and gives 80 g total. Hitec HS-311 is an ordinary standard analog-servo value proxy: 43 g and 3.7 kg·cm at 6 V per Hitec; Tower lists $16.99 each and In Stock. The quote prices only two servo units; the bundled linkage remains unpriced, and no installed model or compatibility is claimed.
